flags.message: Band 'elevated' derives from distribution_count 2, but the first distribution (conference of 6/25/2026) was superseded by a call for response on 6/17/2026 and the second is the post-BIO redistribution for 9/28/2026; the petition has not yet been considered at any conference. The frozen band therefore reads a pre-conference reschedule as a relist, and the elevated 'reached' baseline likely overstates this docket's position. I anchored below it and said so in reasoning.md.
